column1: # Swift definition rule. Recorded: class, struct, enum, actor and extension (all as class; an
# extension is named after the type it extends, at its own line); protocol (interface);
# typealias and associatedtype (type_alias); enum cases (constant); functions (function when free
# or nested in a function, method when in a type or protocol body); init, deinit and subscript
# (method, named by the keyword); operator declarations (function) and operator implementations;
# properties in a type or protocol body (field); file-level let (constant) and var (variable),
# including each name of a tuple pattern.
# Also recorded: macro declarations (function). Not recorded: precedencegroup, locals, parameters, calls, type uses, closure parameters, accessors (get/set/didSet).
# A function with an attribute starts at the attribute line (Shapes.swift 71 and 120).
# Combine2.swift, RequestBase.swift: `@escaping @Sendable (...) -> Void` parameters, private final class bodies and private typealias lines; a class with `@unchecked Sendable`.
